reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for preserving objectives, constraints, and decisions in a workspace-local focus board and reinjecting them into agent context across turns and sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供工作区内持久化的焦点看板，用于记录目标、约束和决策并自动注入上下文。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with a workspace-local persistent focus board for recording objectives, constraints, and decisions and automatically injecting them into context.

capabilities: Provides set, get, append, and clear operations for a durable focus board
Reads and writes board and archive files within the session workspace
Automatically injects focus-board content into agent context
Provides a session projection and experimental read-only web panel
